title: Audiobook Studio Project File
description: This file holds the content of an Audiobook Studio project, including settings like model, API, title, chapters, speakers, their properties, and the snippets containing all the text.

$schema.description: Path or URL of the schema this file validates against.

projectName.description: The name of the project -- usually the title of the book.

speakers.description: The speakers (characters and narrators) available to the project's chapters and snippets.

scenes.description: Reusable scene descriptions that snippets reference to give the TTS model setting and mood context.

chapters.description: An array of chapters in the project, each containing snippets of text.

nullableGuid.description: A GUID without braces, or null.

settings.description: The settings for the project, including model, API, and other configuration options.

apiType.description: The API type used for text generation.

model.description: The model used for text generation.

name.description: The display name of the model.

id.description: The internal model name used for API calls.

description.description: A brief description of the model.

temperature.description: The temperature setting for the model, which controls the expressiveness of the output. A higher value results in more expressive output at the expense of stability.

sampleRate.description: The preferred output audio sample rate.

promptTemplate.description:
The prompt template used for text generation, i.e. the text that will be sent to the TTS model. This template can include placeholders for dynamic content:
{project_title}, {chapter_title}, {speaker_name}, {speaker_role}, {speaker_voice}, {speaker_instructions}, {scene_name}, {scene_context}, {snippet_text}

generationOption.description: The generation option for the project, which determines how snippets are generated.

speaker.description: A character or narrator, with the voice and acting instructions sent to the TTS model.

id.description: A unique identifier for the speaker.

voice_id.description: For Gemini 3.8 TTS, the persistent voice this speaker and any associated snippets will use. Potentially overrides Name, Voice, and Instructions... TBD.

order.description: The order of the speaker in the project's speaker list.

name.description: The display name of the speaker.

voice.description: The name of the Gemini prebuilt voice used for this speaker.

instructions.description: Free-text character and delivery notes sent to the model as the speaker's style.

isNarrator.$comment: Draft 07 has no 'deprecated' keyword; it is marked in the description only.
isNarrator.description: DEPRECATED. Marks a speaker as a default/narrator. Multiple speakers may be marked and none are treated differently; the default speaker for unassigned snippets is the chapter's globalSpeaker.

scene.description: A setting description that gives the TTS model context for the snippets that reference it.

id.description: A unique identifier for the scene.

name.description: The display name of the scene.

description.description: The scene context text sent to the model. Lines are separated by \n.

order.description: The order of the scene in the project's scene list.

wordTimestamp.description: A timestamp for a single word in an audio snippet.

word.description: The word spoken in the audio snippet.

startMs.description: The start time of the word in milliseconds, relative to the start of the audio snippet.

endMs.description: The end time of the word in milliseconds, relative to the start of the audio snippet.

audioSnippet.description: A snippet of audio generated for a snippet, with timestamps for each word.

id.description: A deterministic UUIDv5 for the audio snippet taken from the generationId as the namespace and snippetId as the name.

snippetId.description: The ID of the snippet this audio snippet belongs to.

generationId.description: The ID of the generation this audio snippet belongs to.

startMs.description: The start time of the audio snippet in milliseconds, relative to the start of the generation's audio.

endMs.description: The end time of the audio snippet in milliseconds, relative to the start of the generation's audio.

words.description: An array of word timestamps for the audio snippet.

generation.description: One audio generation result for a snippet, recording the inputs used to produce it.

id.description: A unique identifier for the generation.

snippetId.description: The ID(s) of the snippet this generation belongs to.

speakerId.description: The ID of the speaker that was resolved for this generation (the snippet's speaker, or the chapter's global speaker when the snippet's speaker is null).

timestamp.description: When the generation was created, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

model.description: The ID of the model used for the generation.

text.description: The text sent to the model, including any inline delivery tags such as [whispering].

audioMimeType.description: The MIME type of the returned audio, including parameters.

duration.description: The length of the generated audio in seconds.

temperature.description: The temperature used for the generation.

snippet.description: A block of text in a chapter, assigned to a speaker and scene, with its generation history.

id.description: A unique identifier for the snippet.

speaker.description: The ID of the speaker for the snippet. If null, the chapter's global speaker is used.

sceneId.description: The ID of the scene used in this snippet, or null for none.

order.description: The order of the snippet in the chapter.

collapsed.description: Whether the snippet is collapsed in the UI.

activeGenerationId.description: The ID of the generation selected as the snippet's audio, or null if none.

text.description: The text content of the snippet. Each string represents a separate line.

audioSnippets.description: The audio snippets generated for the snippet, with timestamps for each word.

generations.description: The generation history for the snippet.

chapter.description: A chapter of the project, containing ordered snippets.

id.description: A unique identifier for the chapter.

order.description: The order of the chapter in the project.

globalSpeaker.description: The global speaker for the chapter, which will be used for all snippets in the chapter with a null speaker setting. Basically, the default speaker / narrator.

collapsed.description: Whether the chapter is collapsed in the UI.

content.description: An array of objects representing the chapter's snippets.
